criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
uri_query_params returns an empty list when the URI has no query string (short-circuits before strict parsing), and uses strict parsing when a query is present.
duplicate_params counts keys appearing more than once across BOTH decoded body and query params and guards against a None body without erroring.

generate_signed_token builds an RS256 JWT whose claims include scope and an exp derived from request.expires_in merged with request.claims, and verify_signed_token decodes/verifies it returning the claims dict (sign/verify round-trips).
